scope: All 34 existing assets: manual geometry, material and orientation review against recorded/rendered RGB-D pairs. No new clutter assets.

assets.name: room_door1
assets.review: Lever handles, round roses, hinge hardware, and subtler vertical wood grain; fitted doorway pose retained.

assets.name: room_door2
assets.review: Lever handles and wood grain; doorway dimensions and hinge placement retained.

assets.name: sofa
assets.review: Retained cushions, arm proportions, feet, and pose; reduced coarse fabric texture scale.

assets.name: bed
assets.review: Unequal cardboard supports and seams, lighter cardboard, and finer mattress weave; mattress dimensions and pose retained.

assets.name: pillow
assets.review: Thinner blue-gray piping and finer fabric; rounded shape and pose retained.

assets.name: folded_blanket
assets.review: Soft rounded overlapping folds replace flat stacked slabs; lighter gray textile.

assets.name: desk
assets.review: Reversed monitor orientation to face into the room, corrected monitor proportions, and rebuilt two T legs.

assets.name: office_chair

assets.name: round_stool

assets.name: red_tool_bag
assets.review: Reduced body and handle height to match the flatter fabric bag on the stool.

assets.name: traffic_cone
assets.review: Retained red base, taper, two white bands, and position.

assets.name: white_cabinet

assets.name: tall_shelf
